snapshot_scope: 38 draft/open PRs returned by GitHub API in current research portfolio (not all independent experiments)
frozen_baselines: Do not modify historical frozen scientific results to obtain positive claims
Do not merge or deploy research-only cryptography as production security
A PASS on synthetic test fixtures is not experimental confirmation
No new neural result for Phase 2U until the independently verifiable predicted ranking is sealed

status_vocabulary.frozen_result_pr_disposition_open: Original study concluded, historical PR documentation/integration disposition not closed
status_vocabulary.blocked_reproducibility: Interpretation blocked on a reproducibility or provenance anomaly
status_vocabulary.exploratory_prospective_open: Hypothesis-generating work with independent confirmatory experiment still undone
status_vocabulary.valid_blocked_protocol_retained: Original prospective protocol no longer executable as registered; preserve incident
status_vocabulary.source_complete_prediction_not_frozen: Prospective classical source generation complete; no sealed neural prediction
status_vocabulary.experimental_result_audit_open: Genuine study result exists but output-only independently verified report and/or extension remains open
status_vocabulary.model_validated_hardware_and_persistence: Model/synthetic claims bounded; durable real-world guarantees open
status_vocabulary.ci_failed_security_gate: Latest checked exact branch CI failing on security-sensitive checks
status_vocabulary.prototype_ci_green_security_open: Tests pass; full protocol security review and adversarial validation missing
status_vocabulary.demonstrator_scope_complete: Original research demonstrator can be closed at its explicitly narrow scope
status_vocabulary.smoke_only_full_experiment_open: Short smoke test passed; original scientific budget not executed

review_rules.gate_policy: Every workstream's exit checklist requires separately logged evidence and a dated human review; absence of evidence is not PASS
review_rules.safety_boundary: ToySPN, TPM, RAVEN and research crypto components must not be represented as deployed secure systems
review_rules.authenticity_note: SHA-256 receipts detect alteration but are not authenticated source provenance without independent source/runner review
review_rules.secure_core_blocker: 5 failures on 2026-10-25 branch #154 must not be bypassed by weakening pVM attestation trust gate
